name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-user-provisioning-center
title: User Provisioning Center
shortDescription: Client-only SPFx web part for employee onboarding, transfer and offboarding in Microsoft 365 — no Azure Functions, no custom backend. Runs as a SharePoint web part, a Teams tab and a Teams personal app.
longDescription: User Provisioning Center runs employee onboarding, transfers and offboarding out of Microsoft 365 with no Azure Functions and no custom backend. Every operation is a delegated Microsoft Graph call made from the browser under the signed-in operator's own permissions; job state, tasks, templates and the audit trail live in SharePoint lists. Anything Graph genuinely can't do from a client context is routed to a service-desk task instead of failing the job silently.

references.name: Build your first SharePoint client-side web part
references.description: Client-side web parts are client-side components that run in the context of a SharePoint page. Client-side web parts can be deployed to SharePoint environments that support the SharePoint Framework. You can also use modern JavaScript web frameworks, tools, and libraries to build them.
